stage1_candidates.G1: V1a.4 R2b presence with native per-slice geometry
stage1_candidates.G2: R2b presence with nearest reliable B1-anchor box copied onto recovered side-slices
stage1_candidates.G3: R2b presence with z-axis linear box trend estimated from the nearest 5 reliable B1 anchors and extrapolated/interpolated onto recovered side-slices

stage1_policy.advance_rule: A geometry-recovery candidate may advance only if recovered-side prompt geometry improves over G1 without changing R2b presence or any non-recovered geometry.
